authority: Model-authored host audit of frozen source requirements and exact source passages; not expert gold or empirical wet-lab validation.
scope: Compare source-derived coverage judgments, factual fidelity and applicability, without reading revised Workflow candidates or active native reviews and without feedback to either run.

same_source_comparison.baseline_copy_custody: The inspected baseline source_obligations.json is the completed 001 source-author ledger copied into the completed 005 reviewer input; it is not a reviewer rewrite. Raw SHA matches the prior source-stage receipt.
same_source_comparison.source_recovery_claim: No newly acquired scientific document is demonstrated by this comparison; all facts are from the same nine registered sources.

separate_evaluation_axes.question: For each assertion actually made, does the evidence license its truth and its applicable route/material/measurement context?
separate_evaluation_axes.consequence: Included optional details still need faithful support. A correct required fact does not license adjacent unsupported prose.

separate_evaluation_axes.question: Would omission make the declared output, mechanism, identity, interface or interpretation unsupported or ambiguous?
separate_evaluation_axes.consequence: A reported number or analysis choice is not automatically a mandatory completeness item. Necessary identities, fractions, selected mechanisms and decoding interfaces cannot be waived merely because a candidate omitted them.

separate_evaluation_axes.question: Can this item be selected and adjudicated under one actual route/endpoint antecedent?
separate_evaluation_axes.consequence: Separate different route or endpoint predicates. Do not force one Operation, sentence, reaction, numerical parameter or node per item.

summary.judgment: The revised ledger is a partial improvement in scope discipline and conditional decomposition, not a demonstrated solution to fallible coverage judgments.
summary.improved: Culture execution, imaging resources, library sizing, manufacturer internals and downstream clustering are more clearly separated from core interfaces. Required items more often state actual route conditions and a concrete omission consequence.
summary.remaining: Some cards still combine independently applicable routes or endpoint predicates, and mechanistically necessary interfaces remain bundled with fixed execution-scale details whose necessity is not separately justified.
summary.not_a_result: No candidate accuracy, revised gate accuracy, latency gain, reduction in hallucination, generalization or success on held-out methods is established by this source-stage comparison.

descriptive_metrics.interpretation: Counts, rationale uniqueness, exact quote matching and schema validity are descriptive integrity checks. More obligations or more distinctive prose do not measure necessity, source comprehension or downstream accuracy.

instruction_change_observed.revised_contract: Explicitly separates accuracy of included detail from necessary scope coverage, requests one independently applicable coverage predicate, a concrete omission consequence and actual conditional antecedents, and forbids requiring every study-specific number or complete commercial recipe.
instruction_change_observed.comparison_limit: The original baseline 001 prompt was not locally inspected; do not attribute all observed output differences to this prompt alone or present an exact prompt-diff causal experiment.

specific_improvements.claim: Separate necessary specimen identity from optional routine culture execution.

before.requirement: Start with live cultured cells retaining membrane-associated PHOs before dissociation; preserve demonstrated HeLa/U2OS monolayer scope. If culture preparation is represented, retain high-glucose DMEM/GlutaMAX/sodium pyruvate, 10% FBS, 1% Pen-Strep, 37°C/5% CO2 and fibronectin-coated glass imaging substrates. Do not assert demonstrated dense or complex three-dimensional tissue performance.
before.rationale: Preserves a consequential transformation or attribution interface in the frozen general-method scope.

after.requirement: Identify the supported starting material as live cultured cells/monolayers, with HeLa and U2OS as source implementations, and retain glass-bottom, fibronectin-coated presentation for microscopy and the protein-patterned presentation for the iterative implementation.
after.rationale: The specimen and optical presentation constrain the supported path to spatial encoding; omitting them implies unsupported tissue applicability.

after.requirement: Retain source culture conditions when describing preparation: high-glucose DMEM with GlutaMAX and sodium pyruvate, 10% FBS and 1% Pen-Strep, 37°C and 5% CO2; source routine passaging is 1:6 at 70–80% confluence with 0.25% trypsin-EDTA.
after.condition: When detailing culture of the source HeLa/U2OS implementations.
after.rationale: These are useful preparation details, but reproducing the source maintenance schedule is not needed to define spatial encoding and readout.

specific_improvements.limits: This supports less indiscriminate coverage pressure, not proof that every revised specimen clause has a correct applicability predicate.

specific_improvements.claim: Separate description of optional visualization choices from optional imaging equipment and processing.

before.requirement: Preserve optional fluorophore configurations: inner Cy3/outer Cy5, outer-only Cy3, Cy5 or FAM, or neither element labeled. Fluorescence can assess embedding/photocleavage before sequencing, but is not required for molecular spatial encoding. Do not require dual labeling or fluorescence imaging in every route.
before.rationale: An explicitly optional visualization channel should remain separate from the PHO sequencing carrier.

before.requirement: When a fluorophore readout is used, retain pre/post illumination fluorescence and its element identity as QC data, distinct from sequencing counts. Reported imaging uses Nikon Ti-2/Yokogawa CSU-W1 SoRa/Andor iXon Life 888, 20x or 10x objectives, and 488/561/640 nm lasers for FAM/Cy3/Cy5. For dual-label gradient characterization Cy5/Cy3 is calculated after threshold/background removal and per-channel normalization; outer-only later imaging uses one z-plane/channel instead.
before.condition: Fluorophore-conjugated PHOs are used for fluorescence QC or measurement; this visualization branch is optional overall.
before.rationale: Keeps optical measurements and their normalization qualified by the actual fluorescent design rather than treating them as molecular sequencing readout.

after.requirement: Preserve the optional visual readout designs: 3′ inner Cy3 plus 3′ outer Cy5; 3′ outer-only Cy3, Cy5 or FAM; or no fluorophore. Keep pre/post cleavage imaging as optional QC/quantification, not as an obligatory encoding reagent or reported adaptive illumination controller.
after.rationale: The source offers assay implementations with and without imaging; omitting this choice makes the prerequisites of spatial encoding ambiguous.

after.requirement: When included, bind imaging to the Nikon Ti-2/CSU-W1 SoRa/Andor iXon setup, 10× or 20× objectives and 488/561/640 nm excitation for FAM/Cy3/Cy5; retain that the initial dual-channel three-plane analysis differed from later single-plane outer-only imaging.
after.condition: When representing fluorescence inspection or image-based photocleavage measurement.
after.rationale: These details qualify the source visual measurement rather than define the sequencing endpoint.

after.requirement: Preserve the distinction between image processing and sequencing counts: source nd2/FIJI/tiff/custom MATLAB/Python processing and, for the initial dual-color gradient measurement, saturation/background handling, normalization and Cy5/Cy3 intensity ratios.
after.condition: When including the initial image-derived cleavage measurement.
after.rationale: These are optional visual corroboration measurements, not an alternative definition of sequencing UMIs or proof of an adaptive control loop.

specific_improvements.limits: Requiring explicit optionality does not require a fluorescent branch in every physical execution.

specific_improvements.claim: Separate indexed-library construction from optional size inspection.

before.requirement: Retain PCR2 sample-index extension: 7 μL treated PCR1 aliquot, 22.5 μL 2x mix, 2 μL each 10 μM RPI and Illumina sample-index primer, water to 45 μL; 6–12 cycles at the same 94/60/72°C durations. Add 5 μL ExoSAP-IT/37°C 15 min, then 1.2x double-sided SPRI (0.90x left/0.30x right), two 80% ethanol washes and 20 μL elution. Retain Bioanalyzer fragment-size measurement as QC data without inventing an adaptive loading rule.
before.rationale: Preserves a consequential transformation or attribution interface in the frozen general-method scope.

after.requirement: Preserve the production aliquot and second indexed PCR: 5 µL first-PCR product plus 2 µL ExoSAP-IT, 37°C 15 min; use that 7 µL with 22.5 µL 2× master mix, 2 µL each 10 µM RPI and sample-index primers to 45 µL, then 6–12 cycles at 94°C 10 s/60°C 30 s/72°C 30 s. Do not route the entire first PCR as if the aliquot were a perfect copy.
after.condition: For spatial library preparation by the plate workflow and its source-described delegation in droplet/scSTAMP-MAT routes.
after.rationale: The selected fraction and index addition define the material that actually proceeds to the final spatial library.

after.requirement: Preserve the second ExoSAP-IT treatment (5 µL into the 45 µL reaction, 37°C 15 min), 1.2× double-sided SPRI selection (0.90× left/0.30× right), two 80% ethanol washes and 20 µL water elution as the final spatial library purification.
after.condition: For spatial library preparation by the plate workflow and its source-described delegation in droplet/scSTAMP-MAT routes.
after.rationale: The sequenceable spatial DNA library is the retained purified product, not unselected PCR mixture.

after.requirement: Retain source Bioanalyzer 2100 fragment-size inspection where library quality measurement is included, without inventing a pass/fail threshold or a feedback/loading adjustment.
after.rationale: This is useful library characterization but the source does not define it as a control governing the assay route.

specific_improvements.limits: If size inspection is actually asserted, instrument and result claims still require evidence; optional coverage does not relax fidelity.

specific_improvements.claim: Separate a supported commercial transformation boundary from optional manufacturer-revision execution internals.

before.requirement: For the alternative droplet route preserve PN-1000325 LT v3.1 capture through the custom amplification boundary: partitioned cells, poly-A capture of mRNA/PHOs, cell and UMI assignment, and barcoded cDNA recovery. Attribute guide Rev B details separately: released primers contain TruSeq Read 1, 16-nt 10x barcode, 12-nt UMI and 30-nt poly(dT); GEM RT is 53°C 45 min, 85°C 5 min, 4°C hold, followed by GEM breakup and silane-bead cDNA purification. Do not give this route the plate’s six-base RT UMI.
before.condition: The droplet-based transcriptome route is selected.
before.rationale: Reported use of the LT kit supports the delegated boundary; supplied-guide details are manufacturer information with uncertain exact revision correspondence to the primary execution.

after.requirement: Preserve Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 3′ LT v3.1 (1000325) as the alternative capture route, following the 10X workflow to cDNA amplification with the specified scSTAMP modification. At the delegated manufacturer boundary retain GEM cell lysis, released poly(dT) primers and cell-specific barcoded cDNA production; attribute the 16-nt cell barcode/12-nt capture UMI/30-nt poly(dT) architecture to the supplied CG000399 Rev B guide, whose revision the primary does not specify.
after.rationale: This is the prerequisite for droplet cell attribution and prevents borrowing the plate capture UMI or the older MULTI-seq v2 architecture.

after.requirement: Represent the manufacturer-delegated post-GEM emulsion breaking, recovery of pooled barcoded first-strand cDNA, silane magnetic-bead cleanup and cDNA amplification as the transition to amplified material; keep PHO copying/template-switching and its downstream tag primers qualified to the scSTAMP adaptation.
after.rationale: Without this transition, the GEM-associated cell identity is not connected to the recovered spatial/endogenous library substrates.

after.requirement: Manufacturer-specific execution details such as the Rev B GEM-RT program (53°C 45 min, 85°C 5 min, 4°C hold) may be retained with attribution. Do not turn the supplied revision or its optimization guidance into a primary-reported exact execution or demand its entire commercial recipe for a boundary-level assay description.
after.condition: When adding internal commercial execution details to the droplet route.
after.rationale: The named commercial transformation is supported; revision-specific recipe detail is an optional refinement within this general-method scope.

specific_improvements.limits: Barcode/UMI identity is consequential for decoding and remains attributed. The optional thermal program is not evidence the named guide revision was the exact historical execution.

specific_improvements.claim: Separate conditional analyzed-cohort selection from optional downstream clustering.

before.requirement: Retain source-described analytical selection and normalization with variant limits: plate cells >1000 genes and >1000 transcripts and <20% ERCC; droplet cells >200 genes and >200 transcripts and <5% mitochondrial counts. Seurat 4.3.0 log NormalizeData, 2000 variable genes, elbow-selected PCs and FindNeighbors/FindClusters/RunUMAP produce expression structure; cell annotation uses known markers and, where stated, PHO/MPO counts. These are reported analysis rules, not universal assay-intrinsic viability or light-dose feedback controls.
before.rationale: Preserves a consequential transformation or attribution interface in the frozen general-method scope.

after.requirement: Preserve reported analysis-stage cell selection separately from wet-lab capture: plate cells have >1,000 genes and >1,000 unique transcripts and <20% ERCC; droplet cells have >200 genes and >200 unique transcripts and <5% mitochondrial counts. ERCC is an introduced plate reference, not an endogenous transcript category.
after.condition: When representing the source-defined downstream analyzed transcriptome cohort.
after.rationale: The analyzed cell cohort and interpretation of transcript counts would otherwise be ambiguous, and measurement filters could be mistaken for capture controls.

after.requirement: Source downstream expression analysis can include Seurat 4.3.0 log normalization, 2,000 variable genes, elbow selection of PCs, FindNeighbors/FindClusters/RunUMAP and marker/spatial/MPO-assisted group labels. Keep this separate from molecular counting and spatial encoding.
after.condition: When extending the declared endpoint to source-style expression normalization/clustering.
after.rationale: These are useful analysis choices; reproducing the clustering/figures is not necessary for the general assay’s count readout.

specific_improvements.limits: The revised cohort-selection card still combines plate and droplet antecedents; see residual R01.

record.requirement: Preserve reported analysis-stage cell selection separately from wet-lab capture: plate cells have >1,000 genes and >1,000 unique transcripts and <20% ERCC; droplet cells have >200 genes and >200 unique transcripts and <5% mitochondrial counts. record.condition: When representing the source-defined downstream analyzed transcriptome cohort.

baseline_record.requirement: Retain oligo stock preparation and annealing as prerequisites: water-resuspended 100 μM stocks protected from light at −20°C; 2.4 μL each 100 μM PHO and anchor plus 7.2 μL IDT duplex buffer makes 20 μM intermediate, 94°C 3 min then cool 1°C/min to 4°C and hold; make 500 nM working stock immediately before use, on ice or light-protected −20°C. MPO substitutes for PHO when its branch is used.
baseline_record.rationale: Preserves a consequential transformation or attribution interface in the frozen general-method scope.

revised_record.requirement: Retain aqueous primary stocks protected from light and stored at −20°C; preserve the equimolar PHO/anchor annealing recipe (2.4 µL each at 100 µM plus 7.2 µL duplex buffer; 20 µM intermediate), 94°C for 3 min then −1°C/min to 4°C, and 500 nM working stock kept cold and light-protected.
revised_record.rationale: Without prepared PHO/anchor duplexes and their reported conditions, the input to live membrane labeling is undefined.

remaining_scope_and_necessity_risks.finding: Prepared PHO/anchor duplex identity is consequential. The revised rationale does not separately explain why a fixed stock scale of 2.4/2.4/7.2 uL or every stock-storage detail is necessary to a general method graph. The premise that input would be undefined without all reported conditions overstates the necessity argument. This is not a claim those source values are false, nor permission to omit consequential stoichiometry, material identity or selected conditions.

frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.theme: The registered assay labels live cell membranes before single-cell sequencing; its demonstrated specimens include HeLa/U2OS cultures. The paper does not establish performance in dense, pronounced three-dimensional tissues.
frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.comparison: Live-cell specimen and 3D limit preserved; routine culture schedule separated as optional. The revised unqualified specimen card still mentions the iterative presentation, whose application is route-specific.

frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.theme: A PHO has inner and outer 50-nt DNA sequences linked by a UV-sensitive photolabile moiety. Each contains a PCR handle, an inner/outer identity barcode, a 6-nt molecular UMI and a poly-A capture sequence; these roles must not be conflated.
frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.comparison: Core carrier domains and inner/outer ratio reference remain explicit. Domain and barcode identities are consequential, unlike arbitrary stock scale.

frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.theme: The inner PHO handle hybridizes to a cholesterol-modified anchor; sequential co-anchor incubation supports membrane embedding/retention. The anchor has a 3′ amino modifier intended to prevent unwanted downstream amplification.
frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.comparison: Anchor/co-anchor hybridization, membrane association and amino block remain represented; exact stock preparation is still bundled with the necessary duplex interface.

frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.theme: Membrane labeling and illumination precede dissociation. The resulting cell suspension is captured either by plate FACS or by the distinct 10X droplet route; those alternatives are not one serial capture execution.
frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.comparison: Encoding before collection and alternative capture remain represented. No fixed node count is needed to encode this order.

frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.theme: The light-dependent outer-to-inner PHO count ratio is the sequence-derived indicator of cleavage/light exposure used to infer position from a known illumination pattern; position is not directly measured as a genomic coordinate by the sequencer.
frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.comparison: Ratio-based inference and known illumination map remain represented; revised ledger marks an information-dependency inference rather than inventing direct coordinate measurement.

frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.theme: Fluorophore conjugation and image-based cleavage inspection are supported optional PHO variants; a nonfluorescent PHO design is explicitly described. Imaging validation is not automatically a decision-controlled gate in every sequencing route.
frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.comparison: Optional physical visualization choices are required to be described as choices; exact microscope/image-analysis implementation is optional. Required description of an alternative is not required use of that alternative.

frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.theme: In the plate transcriptomic route, the poly-T capture primer supplies a cell barcode, 6-nt UMI, Illumina adapter and T7 promoter; it reverse transcribes mRNA and copies PHO DNA before second-strand synthesis. Resulting library intermediates must be described as DNA products rather than newly synthesized double-stranded RNA.
frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.comparison: Plate-specific capture identity and DNA products remain represented. Revised cards separate capture, first strand and cell-barcode-enabled pooling; precise resource details still exceed what their necessity rationales individually establish.

frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.theme: Plate wells are pooled only after products have the cell-specific capture barcode; PHO, MPO when present, and endogenous mRNA-derived products from a cell share its capture barcode.
frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.comparison: New MPO decoding card explicitly joins sample identity to cells via the shared capture barcode. The earlier baseline source-stage audit described this theme as broad/partial; the exact baseline fragments are mapped here without silently changing that audit.

frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.theme: The first plate size selection retains endogenous cDNA on 0.7x SPRI beads and short spatial-barcode products in the supernatant, which must be transferred rather than discarded. The spatial fraction is subsequently recovered using added 2.5x beads and 1.8x isopropanol relative to the original sample volume.
frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.comparison: Retention and transfer of the short-product supernatant are explicit in both. Revised card records the plate antecedent and qualifies transfer of its recipe to other routes.

frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.theme: The plate route amplifies PHO-derived spatial DNA by PCR, whereas endogenous cDNA proceeds through IVT and subsequent Illumina library preparation. The spatial protocol uses a 5-µL aliquot of first PCR product for ExoSAP-IT before the next PCR; no fate of the unwithdrawn remainder is specified by that aliquot statement.
frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.comparison: PCR versus IVT and the 5-uL PCR aliquot are represented in both; revised separates optional fragment sizing. Neither absence of a required remainder-fate assertion nor an unspecified remainder licenses a fabricated disposal path. Prior baseline broad/partial classification is retained as history.

frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.theme: The droplet route adapts the 10X Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 3′ LT v3.1 workflow through cDNA amplification using custom inner/outer PHO handle primers, then uses a 0.6x AMPure first separation. Endogenous products resume the 10X library route; spatial products use the plate spatial-library strategy. However, the registered Supplementary Figure 10 caption states that PHO separation occurs prior to cDNA amplification. This is an apparent ordering tension requiring contextual attribution; these passages alone do not prove identical amplification meaning or an irreconcilable contradiction.
frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.comparison: Both qualify the source/supplement order tension. Revised separates reported commercial boundary/identity from optional revision-specific recipe internals; supplied guide is not a primary execution record.

frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.theme: In scSTAMP-MAT, mRNA reverse transcription/PHO copying and M.CviPI GpC methylation of open chromatin occur simultaneously after cell lysis. Cell-and-origin-specific transcript/PHO barcoding and accessibility marking are different information channels.
frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.comparison: Simultaneous biochemical encoding and DNA products remain explicit with dependency attribution. Source-ledger decomposition is not a required graph decomposition.

frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.theme: After second-strand synthesis in scSTAMP-MAT, 5hmC is glucosylated to block MspJI detection; MspJI cuts methylated genomic DNA and ds adapters supply cell/gDNA-origin barcodes, UMI, Illumina handle and T7 promoter before pooling. Short PHO products are separated from mRNA/gDNA-derived molecules, which take the corresponding PCR versus IVT routes. The target-specific supplement further specifies protease-mediated chromatin stripping before glucosylation and, after IVT, polyA-biotin/streptavidin separation of mRNA-derived and gDNA-derived molecules before the corresponding endogenous libraries.
frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.comparison: Methylation-sensitive genomic readout, cell-origin barcodes, IVT and material allocation remain represented. Both preserve an unknown exact allocation rather than assigning discarded enrichment supernatant to the genome library.

frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.theme: The scSTAMP-MAT genomic read classification uses methylated-cytosine context: CpG contributes to the methylome and GpC to the accessibility dataset. The final context-derived accessibility interpretation is distinct from the directly sequenced genomic fragment.
frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.comparison: Source-qualified read context remains explicit; revised separates delegated read requirements from an unsupported claim about every historical sequencing run.

frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.theme: For PHO sequencing, read 1 supplies the cell barcode/UMI; read 2 identifies inner/outer PHO sequence and downstream spatial barcode/UMI. Unique molecule counts combine UMIs from both reads; MPO identification adds its multiplex identifier from read 2 when MPOs were used.
frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.comparison: Read1/read2 identity and joint molecular uniqueness are represented in both. These exact identities are coverage-critical when the decoding is selected.

frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.theme: Sequential optical barcoding is a source-described alternative using newly unique PHOs and successive light masks with washing between cycles; it is distinct from adding several PHOs simultaneously for noise reduction. The current PHO chemistry has no protected memory against later illumination.
frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.comparison: Sequential repeated labeling/masks and combinatorial decoding are separated, with the real route antecedent; no unsupported protected-memory assumption is introduced.

frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.theme: The reported multi-PHO noise-reduction demonstration defines effective ratio regions using the source-described 10%/90% thresholds for known illumination levels, combines assignments across PHOs by highest count, and treats top-count ties as incorrect rather than guaranteed spatial assignments.
frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.comparison: Reference-dose distributions and decision rules are now separately applicable obligations within the same selected estimator; one source-qualified information-dependency inference is explicitly marked inferred.

frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.theme: The actual droplet compatibility and scSTAMP-MAT demonstrations used floodlight exposures, whereas the paper also demonstrates DMD-based spatial patterns elsewhere. A generalized patterned-light-plus-downstream-route architecture is not the same as a directly demonstrated patterned droplet/MAT experiment.
frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.comparison: Actual floodlight droplet/MAT demonstration scope is more explicitly separated from general patterned illumination compatibility; exact apparatus-dependent dose examples are not a universal operating rule.

frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.theme: For the reported accessibility/methylation comparison, scSTAMP-MAT analysis uses specified genomic normalization including bulk HeLa DNA methylated at GpC after chromatin stripping. That characterization/normalization dependency is not an automatic production control gate for every single-cell library.
frozen_twenty_theme_mapping.comparison: Independent bulk reference remains separate from single-cell sample material. Revised avoids silently copying H9 quantitative conditions onto primary HeLa, but still bundles across-dataset and within-sample normalization predicates.
